text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it affirmed its AA minus long-term and A1 plus short-term ratings on RTZ-CRA and its guaranteed related entities.
The outlook is stable, S&P said in a statement.
S&P said it expected RTZ-CRA to maintain a strong financial profile to counterbalance the inevitable cyclical downturns in the industry.
"Current ratings factor in a mondest increase in leverage over the next few years given its capital investment programme," S&P said.
S&P said it affirmed the following ratings. The RTZ Corp Plc AA minus/A1 plus
S&P also affirmed the following ratings for entites guaranteed by RTZ-CRA.
RTA America Holding Inc (formerly RTZ America Inc)
RTZ America Inc - "new' RTZ America AA minus/A1 plus
RTZ Canada Holdings Inc AA minus/A1 plus
RTZ Canada Inc AA minus/A1 plus
RTZ Finance Overseas Ltd A1 plus
Rio Tinto Zinc Finance BV AA minus
